title.zh: 卷326 列傳一百十三 开泰 阿尔泰 桂林 温福
title.en: Volume 326 Biographies 113: Kai Tai, A Er Tai, Gui Lin, Wen Fu
title.raw: 卷326 列傳一百十三 开泰 阿尔泰 桂林 温福

sentences.zh: =開泰=開泰，烏雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: = Kai Tai = Kai Tai, of the Wuya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai, of the Wuya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng he passed the jinshi examination, was made a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷侍講。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to Reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 上御門，開泰未入侍班，黜令乾清門行走。

translations.literal: When the emperor held court at the Gate, Kai Tai had not entered the attendance roster and was demoted to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor held audience at the Gate, Kai Tai had not taken his place in the attendance roster and was demoted to duty at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 十三年，复編修。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was restored as compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was reappointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，遷國子監司業。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was transferred to Vice-Director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he became Vice-Director of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷祭酒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Chancellor of the Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He supervised education in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner for Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 再遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Grand Secretary of the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 三遷兵部侍郎，仍留學政任。

translations.literal: After three further promotions he became Vice Minister of War, while retaining his post as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After three more promotions he became Vice Minister of War while keeping his educational commission.

sentences.zh: 十年，授湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「社倉較常平尤近於民，而弊亦易滋。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Community granaries are even closer to the people than Ever-Normal granaries, yet abuses also arise more easily.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: "Community granaries lie even closer to the people than the Ever-Normal granaries, yet corruption is also easier to breed there.

sentences.zh: 湖北社倉穀麥五十二萬石有奇，散在諸鄉，恐多虧缺。

translations.literal: Hubei's community granaries held more than 520,000 shi of grain and wheat, scattered among the townships; he feared much would be lost or short.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's community granaries held over 520,000 shi of grain and wheat spread through the countryside, and he feared heavy losses and shortages.

sentences.zh: 應飭道府按部所至，便宜抽驗。

translations.literal: Circuit intendants and prefectures should be ordered, wherever their inspection tours reach, to sample and verify as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He urged that circuit and prefectural officials be instructed to conduct spot checks wherever their tours took them.

sentences.zh: 」調江西。

translations.literal: " He was transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，又調湖南。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred again, to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was moved to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「戶部諮各省常平倉穀，以雍正舊額為準。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Ministry of Revenue has consulted the provinces on Ever-Normal granary grain, taking the Yongzheng-era quotas as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Ministry of Revenue has asked each province about Ever-Normal granary stocks, using the Yongzheng quotas as the baseline.

sentences.zh: 湖南溢額穀五十五萬餘石，令糶價儲庫。

translations.literal: Hunan's surplus grain exceeded the quota by more than 550,000 shi, with orders to sell it and store the proceeds in the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's surplus amounted to more than 550,000 shi above quota, with orders to sell the grain and deposit the proceeds in the treasury.

sentences.zh: 臣維雍正舊額七十餘萬石。

translations.literal: Your servant considers the Yongzheng-era quota to be more than 700,000 shi.
translations.idiomatic: I maintain that the Yongzheng quota was over 700,000 shi.

sentences.zh: 湖南夙稱產米，乾隆二年至八年，諸省赴湖南購米，先後計百七十五萬有奇。

translations.literal: Hunan has long been renowned for rice; from Qianlong 2 to 8 various provinces sent agents to Hunan to purchase rice, totaling more than 1,750,000 [shi].
translations.idiomatic: Hunan has long been known as a rice-producing region; from Qianlong 2 through 8 other provinces bought rice there, totaling more than 1.75 million shi.

sentences.zh: 中間又撥運福建、江蘇。

translations.literal: In between grain was also allocated and shipped to Fujian and Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: During that period additional shipments were dispatched to Fujian and Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 若盡糶溢額之穀，遇本省需用或鄰疆告糴，必致倉儲缺額，買補不易。

translations.literal: If all surplus grain were sold off, whenever this province needed supplies or a neighboring region requested grain, granary stocks would fall short and replenishment would be difficult.
translations.idiomatic: If the entire surplus were sold, any local need or neighboring request for grain would leave the granaries short and hard to refill.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，以留心積貯嘉之。

translations.literal: " When the memorial reached the throne, the emperor praised his attention to stockpiling.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor commended his care for grain reserves when the memorial arrived.

sentences.zh: 十五年，有壽掄元者，自言南河同知，赴湖南採木，布政使孫灝諭永州府為料理。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year a man named Shou Lunyuan claimed to be sub-prefect of the Southern Rivers and went to Hunan to procure timber; the provincial treasurer Sun Hao instructed Yongzhou Prefecture to arrange matters for him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year one Shou Lunyuan claimed to be associate prefect of the Southern Rivers and came to Hunan to collect timber; Provincial Treasurer Sun Hao told Yongzhou Prefecture to handle his arrangements.

sentences.zh: 尋得其詐偽狀，開泰以聞，但言灝殊為未諳。

translations.literal: Soon his fraud was discovered; Kai Tai reported it but only said Sun Hao was quite inexperienced.
translations.idiomatic: When the fraud came to light, Kai Tai reported it but described Sun Hao only as seriously inexperienced.

sentences.zh: 上以灝瞻徇，何得但言未諳，知為開泰門生，斥其徇庇，下吏部嚴議，議奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: The emperor said Sun Hao had shown favoritism—how could Kai Tai speak only of inexperience?—knowing Sun was Kai Tai's student, rebuked him for partiality, referred the case to the Ministry of Personnel for strict deliberation; they recommended stripping his office, but the emperor ordered him to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Sun Hao had plainly shown favoritism and asked why Kai Tai spoke only of inexperience; learning Sun was Kai Tai's student, he denounced Kai Tai for shielding him, sent the case to the Ministry of Personnel for severe review, and though they recommended dismissal, ordered him to stay in office.

sentences.zh: 尋調貴州。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年，疏言：「古州募軍屯田，戶上田六畝，中田八畝，下田十畝。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he memorialized: "At Guzhou, enlisted soldiers farmed garrison land: six mu for upper-grade fields per household, eight for middle-grade, ten for lower-grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he memorialized: "At Guzhou recruited troops farmed garrison fields allotting six mu of top-grade land per household, eight of middle grade, and ten of lower grade.

sentences.zh: 今食指日多，生計艱難，請準屯戶入伍充兵。

translations.literal: Now mouths to feed grow daily and livelihoods are hard; request permission for garrison households to enroll as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: As dependents increase and livelihoods grow strained, he asked that garrison households be allowed to enlist as regular soldiers.

sentences.zh: 」許之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 擢湖廣總督，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: He was promoted Governor-General of Huguang and given the concurrent title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor-general of Huguang and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十年，調四川。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 金川土司莎羅奔與革布什咱土司色楞敦多布初為婚媾，繼乃相怨構兵。

translations.literal: The Jinchuan chieftain Salobe and the Geshiza chieftain Selengdunduobu were first linked by marriage, but later grew resentful and raised troops against each other.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinchuan chieftain Salobe and the Geshiza chieftain Selengdunduobu were first joined by marriage, then fell out and took up arms against each other.

sentences.zh: 旁近綽斯甲布、鄂克什、雜穀、巴旺、丹壩、明正、章谷、小金川諸土司皆不直莎羅奔。

translations.literal: The neighboring chieftains of Zhuosijia Bu, Eke Shi, Zagu, Bawang, Danba, Mingzheng, Zhanggu, and Lesser Jinchuan all disapproved of Salobe.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby chieftains of Zhuosijia Bu, Eke Shi, Zagu, Bawang, Danba, Mingzheng, Zhanggu, and Lesser Jinchuan all sided against Salobe.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，莎羅奔攻吉地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Salobe attacked Jidi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Salobe attacked Jidi.

sentences.zh: 吉地，色楞敦多布所居寨也。

translations.literal: Jidi was the stockade where Selengdunduobu lived.
translations.idiomatic: Jidi was Selengdunduobu's home stockade.

sentences.zh: 開泰與提督岳鍾琪檄游擊楊青、都司夏尚德等率兵分屯章谷、泰宁，令鄂克什、雜穀援革布什咱，攻金川，莎羅奔引退。

translations.literal: Kai Tai and Grand Coordinator Yue Zhongqi issued orders for Brigade Commander Yang Qing, Regimental Commander Xia Shangde, and others to lead troops and garrison Zhanggu and Taining separately, directing Eke Shi and Zagu to aid Geshiza and attack Jinchuan; Salobe withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai and Regional Commander Yue Zhongqi ordered Brigade Commander Yang Qing, Regimental Commander Xia Shangde, and others to station troops at Zhanggu and Taining, directed Eke Shi and Zagu to relieve Geshiza and strike Jinchuan, and Salobe pulled back.

sentences.zh: 尋復攻破吉地，色楞敦多布走泰宁求援，開泰复檄諸土司出兵助之，調雜穀土練千人分屯丹壩、章谷、泰宁，發黎、雅、峨邊兵屯打箭爐，諭郎卡撤兵。

translations.literal: Soon Salobe again broke through Jidi; Selengdunduobu fled to Taining to seek aid; Kai Tai again ordered the chieftains to send troops to help, moved a thousand Zagu native militia to garrison Danba, Zhanggu, and Taining, sent Li, Ya, and Ebian troops to garrison Dajianlu, and instructed Langka to withdraw his forces.
translations.idiomatic: Salobe soon seized Jidi again; Selengdunduobu fled to Taining for help; Kai Tai again called on the chieftains for troops, posted a thousand Zagu militiamen across Danba, Zhanggu, and Taining, sent troops from Li, Ya, and Ebian to Dajianlu, and told Langka to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 郎卡，莎羅奔從子，為副酋，主兵事者也。

translations.literal: Langka was Salobe's nephew, the deputy chieftain who directed military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Langka, Salobe's nephew, served as deputy chieftain and handled military affairs.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上謂：「番目相攻，於打箭爐何與？

translations.literal: When word reached the court, the emperor said: "When tribal chiefs fight one another, what has that to do with Dajianlu?
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, the emperor asked: "When native chiefs fight each other, what business is that of Dajianlu?

sentences.zh: 」疑郎卡擾邊，命開泰具實覆奏。

translations.literal: " Suspecting Langka was disturbing the border, he ordered Kai Tai to report the facts in full.
translations.idiomatic: " Suspecting Langka was harassing the frontier, he ordered Kai Tai to submit a truthful report.

sentences.zh: 開泰尋疏報章谷、巴旺土兵擊敗金川，莎羅奔焚吉地走，盡复革布什咱境，留綽斯甲布、明正兩土司兵分守之，使色楞敦多布歸寨。

translations.literal: Kai Tai soon memorialized that Zhanggu and Bawang native troops had defeated Jinchuan; Salobe burned Jidi and fled, fully recovered Geshiza territory, left Zhuosijia Bu and Mingzheng troops to guard it in divisions, and restored Selengdunduobu to his stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai soon reported that Zhanggu and Bawang native soldiers had routed Jinchuan; Salobe burned Jidi and fled, Geshiza's territory was fully restored, troops from Zhuosijia Bu and Mingzheng were left to hold it, and Selengdunduobu returned to his stockade.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「番民挾仇攻擊，不必繩以內地官法。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "When tribal people attack out of old grudges, there is no need to bind them with the laws of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor directed: "When frontier tribes feud, they need not be judged by interior statutes.

sentences.zh: 宜以番攻番，處以靜鎮。

translations.literal: It is fitting to let tribes fight tribes and handle matters with calm restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Let tribe fight tribe and manage affairs through quiet deterrence.

sentences.zh: 」旋加太子太保。

translations.literal: " He was soon given the concurrent title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " He was soon made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，松潘鎮總兵楊朝棟入覲，開泰與鍾琪奏朝棟衰老，難期勝任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Songpan garrison commander Yang Chaodong came to audience; Kai Tai and Yue Zhongqi memorialized that Chaodong was aged and could hardly be expected to perform well.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Yang Chaodong, commander of the Songpan garrison, came to court; Kai Tai and Yue Zhongqi reported that he was too old to be relied on.

sentences.zh: 上責開泰何以不先奏，下吏部議，奪官，命仍留任。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Kai Tai for not having reported this earlier, referred the case to the Ministry of Personnel, stripped his office by deliberation, but ordered him to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor faulted Kai Tai for not having reported this sooner, sent the case to the Ministry of Personnel, and though they voted to strip his rank, allowed him to keep his post.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，莎羅奔死，郎卡應襲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Salobe died and Langka was to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Salobe died and Langka was due to inherit.

sentences.zh: 例，土司承襲，鄰封諸土司具結。

translations.literal: By precedent, when a native chieftain succeeded, neighboring chieftains submitted joint attestations.
translations.idiomatic: By custom, succession required guaranty bonds from neighboring chieftains.

sentences.zh: 開泰以郎卡與諸土司皆不協，令毋取結，疏聞，上許之，命嚴諭郎卡知恩守法。

translations.literal: Kai Tai, because Langka was at odds with them all, ordered that no bonds be taken; when he reported this, the emperor approved and ordered Langka sternly instructed to know gratitude and obey the law.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai, finding Langka at odds with them all, waived the bonds; the emperor agreed and ordered Langka sternly reminded to show gratitude and keep the law.

sentences.zh: 未幾，郎卡侵丹壩，取所屬瑪讓，開泰檄綽斯甲布往援，使守備溫欽等赴金川詰責。

translations.literal: Before long Langka invaded Danba and seized its dependency Marang; Kai Tai ordered Zhuosijia Bu to aid Danba and sent Assistant Commander Wen Qin and others to Jinchuan to reprimand him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Langka invaded Danba and took Marang under its jurisdiction; Kai Tai called Zhuosijia Bu to Danba's aid and sent Assistant Commander Wen Qin to Jinchuan to rebuke him.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「郎卡狼子野心，即使詰責伏罪，豈肯永守約束？

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Langka has the heart of a wolf cub; even if rebuked and he submits, how can he be trusted to keep his pledges forever?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Langka is wolf-hearted; even if rebuked into submission, will he forever keep his word?

sentences.zh: 諸土司援兵既集，能協力剿除，分據其地，轉可相安；

translations.literal: If the chieftains' allied forces are already gathered and can jointly exterminate him and divide his lands, lasting peace may follow;
translations.idiomatic: If allied chieftain forces are already assembled and can jointly destroy him and partition his territory, peace may follow;

sentences.zh: 若諸部不能並力剿除，而郎卡怙惡不悛，亦非開泰、岳鍾琪四川綠營兵能任其事，應臨時奏請進止。

translations.literal: if the tribes cannot combine to destroy him and Langka persists in evil, neither Kai Tai nor Yue Zhongqi's Sichuan Green Standard troops can bear the task—they should memorialize the throne for decision when the moment comes.
translations.idiomatic: but if they cannot act together and Langka remains unreformed, Kai Tai and Yue Zhongqi's Sichuan Green Standard army cannot finish the job and must report to the throne for orders when needed.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年六月，開泰奏九土司大舉擊破金川。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year Kai Tai memorialized that nine chieftains had launched a major attack and broken Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year Kai Tai reported that nine chieftains had mounted a major assault and crushed Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 上聞郎卡使人詣成都，開泰許進謁，撫慰之，而陰令九土司進兵，諭曰：「郎卡於綽斯甲布等屢肆欺凌，眾土司合力報復。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard Langka had sent envoys to Chengdu, Kai Tai allowed them audience and comforted them, while secretly ordering the nine chieftains to advance; he instructed: "Langka has repeatedly bullied Zhuosijia Bu and the rest; let all chieftains unite in revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Learning Langka had sent envoys to Chengdu, Kai Tai received them and offered reassurance while secretly urging the nine chieftains forward; the emperor said: "Langka has long bullied Zhuosijia Bu and others; the chieftains should unite to repay it.

sentences.zh: 開泰既聞其事，惟應明白宣示，諭令悉銳往攻；

translations.literal: Once Kai Tai heard of this, he should only have announced it plainly and ordered them to attack with full force;
translations.idiomatic: Once Kai Tai knew, he should have declared openly that they must strike with all their strength;

sentences.zh: 而於郎卡來人嚴為拒絕，且諭以爾結怨鄰境，誰肯甘心？

translations.literal: yet toward Langka's envoys he should have refused them sternly and told them: You have made enemies on every border—who will bear it willingly?
translations.idiomatic: toward Langka's envoys he should have refused them outright and said: You have offended every neighbor—who will tolerate you?

sentences.zh: 斷不能曲為庇護。

translations.literal: He absolutely could not shield them unfairly.
translations.idiomatic: He could never bend the rules to protect you.

sentences.zh: 如此，則郎卡既不敢逞強，綽斯甲布等亦可洩忿。

translations.literal: Thus Langka would not dare act boldly and Zhuosijia Bu and the rest could vent their anger.
translations.idiomatic: Then Langka would not dare press his advantage and Zhuosijia Bu and the others could satisfy their grievance.

sentences.zh: 乃既用譎以籠絡郎卡，又隱為各土司援助，郎卡素狡黠，豈能掩其耳目？

translations.literal: Yet he used deceit to win Langka over while secretly aiding the chieftains; Langka has always been cunning—how could his eyes be covered?
translations.idiomatic: Instead he deceived Langka with conciliation while secretly helping the chieftains; Langka is shrewd—how could that escape him?

sentences.zh: 殊非駕馭邊夷之道。

translations.literal: This is far from the way to control frontier tribes.
translations.idiomatic: That is no way to govern frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 」命奪官，以頭等侍衛赴伊犁辦事。

translations.literal: " He was ordered stripped of office and sent as a first-class bodyguard to serve at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: " He was dismissed and sent to Yili as a first-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: =阿爾泰=阿爾泰，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: = Aertai = Aertai, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，以副榜貢生授宗人府筆帖式。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, as a sub-list tribute graduate he was appointed clerk of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng he entered service as a clerk in the Imperial Clan Court through the secondary jinshi list.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，屢遷至山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Under Qianlong he was repeatedly promoted until he became Governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he rose through repeated promotions to governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以山東產山綢，疏請令民間就山坡隙地廣植桲欏，免其昇科。

translations.literal: Because Shandong produced mountain silk, he memorialized asking that the people be allowed to plant oak on hillside gaps widely and be exempted from land-tax increases.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shandong produced mountain silk, he asked that commoners be encouraged to plant oak on spare hillsides without added land tax.

sentences.zh: 歲大水，阿爾泰先後濬兗州、沂州支渠三十有九，曹州、單縣順堤河二百餘裡；

translations.literal: In years of great flood, Aertai successively dredged thirty-nine branch canals in Yanzhou and Yizhou, and more than two hundred li of embankment rivers in Caozhou and Shan County;
translations.idiomatic: In flood years Aertai dredged thirty-nine branch canals in Yanzhou and Yizhou and over two hundred li of levee channels in Caozhou and Shan County;

sentences.zh: 培南旺、蜀山湖民埝；

translations.literal: he raised the Nanwang and Shushan Lake folk dikes;
translations.idiomatic: he strengthened civilian dikes at Nanwang and Shushan lakes;

sentences.zh: 導章丘珍珠、麻塘二泉，新城五龍河溉民田；

translations.literal: he channeled the Zhangqiu Pearl and Matang springs and the Xincheng Wulong River to irrigate farmland;
translations.idiomatic: he led the Zhangqiu Pearl and Matang springs and Xincheng's Wulong River to irrigate fields;

sentences.zh: 並及高苑、博興、惠民諸縣近水地，皆令蓺稻。

translations.literal: and in Gaoyuan, Boxing, Huimin, and other counties near water, all were ordered to plant rice.
translations.idiomatic: and ordered rice planting on lowlands in Gaoyuan, Boxing, Huimin, and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 築洸河堤至於馬場湖，以衛濟寧州城，析白馬湖引入獨山湖以疏泗水，開汶上稻田數百頃。

translations.literal: He built Guang River dikes as far as Machang Lake to protect Jining Prefecture city, diverted Baima Lake into Dushan Lake to drain the Si River, and opened several hundred qing of paddy at Wenshang.
translations.idiomatic: He built Guang River levees to Machang Lake to shield Jining, diverted Baima Lake into Dushan Lake to relieve the Si, and opened hundreds of qing of paddy at Wenshang.

sentences.zh: 濟東諸州縣瀕徒駭、馬頰兩河，支流相貫注，及哨馬營、四女寺支河，皆次第疏治。

translations.literal: Eastern Ji prefectures and counties along the Tuhai and Maji Rivers had interconnected tributaries; the Shaoma Camp and Sinvsi Temple branch rivers were all dredged in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Ji prefectures along the Tuhai and Maji had interlinked tributaries; the Shaoma Camp and Sinvsi branch channels were cleared in sequence.

sentences.zh: 濬衛河自德州至於館陶凡三百餘裡。

translations.literal: He dredged the Wei River from Dezhou to Guantao, more than three hundred li in all.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged more than three hundred li of the Wei River from Dezhou to Guantao.

sentences.zh: 洩壽張積水自沙、趙二河入運，洩東平積水入會泉、大清諸河，洩濟南、東昌諸州縣積水。

translations.literal: He drained Shouzhang's accumulated water through the Sha and Zhao rivers into the Grand Canal, drained Dongping's water into the Huishui and Daqing rivers, and drained accumulated water in Jinan and Dongchang prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He discharged Shouzhang floods through the Sha and Zhao into the Grand Canal, Dongping floods into the Huishui and Daqing rivers, and floodwater across Jinan and Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 開支河三十餘，循官道為壕，引水自壕入支河，自支河入徒駭、大清諸河。

translations.literal: He opened more than thirty branch rivers, dug trenches along the official roads, and led water from the trenches into branch rivers and from branch rivers into the Tuhai and Daqing rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He cut more than thirty branch channels, trenched the highways, and routed water from trenches into branches and from branches into the Tuhai and Daqing.

sentences.zh: 漳、汶合流，開引河，增子埝，以防盛漲。

translations.literal: Where the Zhang and Wen rivers joined, he opened diversion channels and added child dikes against peak floods.
translations.idiomatic: At the Zhang–Wen confluence he opened diversion works and added subsidiary dikes against peak surges.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰撫山東七年，治水利有績，擢四川總督，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Aertai governed Shandong seven years with achievements in water control, was promoted Governor-General of Sichuan, and made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After seven years governing Shandong with notable hydraulic works, he was promoted to Sichuan governor-general and made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰至四川，議平治道路：陸道北訖廣元，西達松潘，東抵夔州，護其傾欹，補其缺落，兼葺大渡河瀘定橋；

translations.literal: When Aertai reached Sichuan he proposed leveling roads: overland routes north to Guangyuan, west to Songpan, east to Kuizhou—shoring inclines, filling gaps, and also repairing the Luding Bridge on the Dadu River;
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Sichuan he proposed road works: land routes north to Guangyuan, west to Songpan, and east to Kuizhou, shoring slopes and gaps and repairing the Luding Bridge on the Dadu;

sentences.zh: 水道自萬縣入湖廣境，鑿治險灘凡一百有奇。

translations.literal: water routes from Wan County into Huguang territory—more than a hundred dangerous rapids were cut through.
translations.idiomatic: water routes from Wan County into Huguang, with more than a hundred hazardous shoals cleared.

sentences.zh: 議以牧廠餘地招佃為田。

translations.literal: He proposed recruiting tenants to farm leftover pasture land.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed leasing abandoned pasture to settlers for farming.

sentences.zh: 議置義倉，捐穀千餘石以倡。

translations.literal: He proposed establishing charity granaries and donated more than a thousand shi of grain to lead the way.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed charity granaries and gave over a thousand shi of grain to start them.

sentences.zh: 議開南川金佛山磺礦。

translations.literal: He proposed opening the sulfur mines of Jinfo Mountain in Nanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed opening the Jinfo Mountain sulfur mines in Nanchuan.

sentences.zh: 議築都江大堰。

translations.literal: He proposed building the great Dujiang irrigation works.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed restoring the great Dujiang irrigation dam.

sentences.zh: 議松潘、雜穀、打箭爐三廳置倉儲麥稞，備邊儲。

translations.literal: He proposed granaries at Songpan, Zagu, and Dajianlu to store wheat and barley for frontier reserves.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed frontier granaries at Songpan, Zagu, and Dajianlu for wheat and barley reserves.

sentences.zh: 上皆從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all his requests.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved every proposal.

sentences.zh: 初，徵金川，以頭人郎卡出降，罷兵。

translations.literal: At first, when Jinchuan was attacked, the headman Langka submitted and troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinchuan was first suppressed, headman Langka surrendered and the campaign ended.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，復為亂，掠丹壩、巴旺。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year disorder broke out again; he raided Danba and Bawang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he rebelled again and raided Danba and Bawang.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰策以番攻番，令旁近綽斯甲布諸土司攻之。

translations.literal: Aertai planned to let tribes fight tribes and ordered nearby Zhuosijia Bu and other chieftains to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai again used tribe-against-tribe strategy and ordered neighboring chieftains including Zhuosijia Bu to attack.

sentences.zh: 秋出行邊，至雜穀腦。

translations.literal: In autumn he went on a frontier tour as far as Zagunao.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he toured the frontier as far as Zagunao.

sentences.zh: 郎卡使請還所侵丹壩碉卡。

translations.literal: Langka asked to return the invaded Danba blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Langka asked to return the Danba forts he had seized.

sentences.zh: 復與提督董天弼進至康巴達，郎卡出謁，阿爾泰許如所請，並畀以新印。

translations.literal: He advanced with Regional Commander Dong Tianbi to Kangbada; Langka came out to audience; Aertai granted his request and also gave him a new seal.
translations.idiomatic: With Regional Commander Dong Tianbi he advanced to Kangbada; Langka came to audience; Aertai agreed and gave him a new seal.

sentences.zh: 疏聞，上戒毋遷就苟安。

translations.literal: When he reported this, the emperor warned against compromising for a quick peace.
translations.idiomatic: On report, the emperor warned him not to settle for an easy peace.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，小金川頭人僧格桑掠鄂克什，阿爾泰赴達木巴宗，僧格桑出謁，還侵地。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year Lesser Jinchuan headman Senggesang raided Eke Shi; Aertai went to Damubazong; Senggesang came to audience and returned the seized lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year Senggesang of Lesser Jinchuan raided Eke Shi; Aertai went to Damubazong; Senggesang attended and restored the territory.

sentences.zh: 尋授武英殿大學士，仍領總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while still governing as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while retaining the governorship.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，召還京，入閣治事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled to the capital to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled to serve in the Grand Council at the capital.

sentences.zh: 既，復令出領總督。

translations.literal: Afterward he was again ordered out to head the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent back to resume the governorship.

sentences.zh: 金川頭人索諾木攻革布什咱，僧格桑亦圍達木巴宗，侵明正土司。

translations.literal: Jinchuan headman Suonuomu attacked Geshiza; Senggesang also besieged Damubazong and invaded the Mingzheng chieftaincy.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan headman Suonuomu attacked Geshiza; Senggesang besieged Damubazong and encroached on Mingzheng.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰疏言：「兩金川相比，如議出師，需兵既多，糜餉亦鉅。

translations.literal: Aertai memorialized: "The two Jinchuans adjoin each other; if troops are sent, many soldiers will be needed and provisions will be vast.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai memorialized: "Greater and Lesser Jinchuan border each other; any campaign would require large forces and immense supplies.

sentences.zh: 茲令董天弼臨之以兵，仍使游擊宋元俊宣諭索諾木。

translations.literal: Now order Dong Tianbi to oversee them with troops, while still sending Brigade Commander Song Yuanjun to proclaim and instruct Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Dong Tianbi to press them with troops while dispatching Brigade Commander Song Yuanjun to proclaim the court's will to Suonuomu.

sentences.zh: 」上責阿爾泰議非是，決策用兵，令定邊右副將軍溫福視師，佐以侍郎桂林，諭斥阿爾泰掩飾偷安，奪大學士、總督，留軍治餉，以桂林代為總督。

translations.literal: " The emperor rebuked Aertai for mistaken counsel, decided to use troops, ordered Frontier Deputy Right General Wen Fu to take command, assisted by Vice Minister Guilin, denounced Aertai for concealment and seeking ease, stripped him of Grand Secretary and Governor-General rank, kept him with the army to manage provisions, and made Guilin governor in his place.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rejected Aertai's proposal, resolved on war, and put Frontier Deputy Right General Wen Fu in command with Vice Minister Guilin as his deputy; he condemned Aertai for evasion and complacency, stripped him of his grand secretary and governorship, kept him with the army to handle supplies, and replaced him with Guilin as governor.

sentences.zh: 師克約咱，上以阿爾泰鑄大砲利軍行，予散秩大臣銜。

translations.literal: When the army took Yuezha, the emperor credited Aertai's casting of cannon for aiding the army's advance and gave him the concurrent rank of minister without portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: After Yuezha fell, the emperor praised Aertai's cannon casting for aiding the campaign and granted him minister-without-portfolio rank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，與總兵宋元俊劾桂林覆軍諱敗，上為罷桂林，即命阿爾泰攝總督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, together with Regional Commander Song Yuanjun he memorialized against Guilin for concealing a routed army and defeat; the emperor dismissed Guilin and immediately ordered Aertai to serve as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he and Regional Commander Song Yuanjun accused Guilin of hiding a catastrophic defeat; the emperor removed Guilin and at once put Aertai in charge as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 俄移督湖廣。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to govern Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon reassigned as governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰疏言：「各路轉餉，當招商承運。

translations.literal: Aertai memorialized: "For supply transport on all routes, merchants should be recruited to undertake carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai memorialized: "Supply transport on every route should be contracted to merchants.

sentences.zh: 西路去內地近，南路山險途長，商不肯應募，當增運值。

translations.literal: The western route is close to the interior; the southern route has treacherous mountains and a long distance—merchants will not answer recruitment; transport fees should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: The western route lies near the interior, but the southern route is mountainous and long, and merchants refuse to sign on unless transport fees are raised.

sentences.zh: 火藥已運罄，當令雲南、陝西協助。

translations.literal: Gunpowder has already been transported to exhaustion; Yunnan and Shaanxi should be ordered to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Gunpowder stocks are exhausted; Yunnan and Shaanxi should be asked to help.

sentences.zh: 」上謂：「阿爾泰專領轉餉，何不早籌畫？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Aertai is solely charged with transporting provisions—why did he not plan early?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Aertai alone oversees supply transport—why did he not plan ahead?

sentences.zh: 今福隆安、阿桂皆至南路，始以一奏塞責。

translations.literal: Now Fukangan and Agui have both reached the southern route before he submits one memorial to fob off responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Fukangan and Agui had both reached the southern front did he file one memorial to dodge responsibility.

sentences.zh: 」命毋往湖廣，仍以散秩大臣留軍督餉。

translations.literal: " He was ordered not to go to Huguang and instead to remain with the army as minister without portfolio supervising provisions.
translations.idiomatic: He was told not to take up Huguang and was kept with the army as minister without portfolio to supervise supplies.

sentences.zh: 未幾，阿桂疏言軍至卡丫，無五日之糧；

translations.literal: Before long Agui memorialized that when the army reached Kayak, it had less than five days' grain;
translations.idiomatic: Soon Agui reported that troops at Kayak had less than five days' rations;

sentences.zh: 又言綽斯甲布轉餉將一月猶未至。

translations.literal: and also that Zhuosijia Bu's supply transport was nearly a month overdue.
translations.idiomatic: and that Zhuosijia Bu's supply convoy was still a month late.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰亦自陳請奪職從軍。

translations.literal: Aertai also submitted a self-accusation asking to be stripped of office and serve in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai also volunteered to be stripped of rank and serve in the field.

sentences.zh: 上責其倚老負恩，始終不肯以國事為念，命逮問。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him for relying on age and repaying grace with ingratitude, never willing to regard state affairs—he ordered him arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor denounced him for abusing his seniority and ingratitude, for never putting the state's interests first, and ordered him arrested.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰初至四川，上以天壇立燈竿，下四川求楠木。

translations.literal: When Aertai first reached Sichuan, the emperor had lamp poles erected at the Temple of Heaven and ordered Sichuan to supply nanmu timber.
translations.idiomatic: When Aertai first arrived in Sichuan, the court was erecting lamp poles at the Temple of Heaven and requisitioning nanmu timber from the province.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰附運木材以進，言出養廉採獻。

translations.literal: Aertai had timber shipped along and presented it, saying it was offered from his integrity stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai shipped timber along as a gift, claiming it came from his integrity stipend.

sentences.zh: 既乃私語人，謂他日且以此負累。

translations.literal: Afterward he privately told someone that someday this would burden him.
translations.idiomatic: Later he confided to someone that this gift would one day become his undoing.

sentences.zh: 語聞上，上心慊之。

translations.literal: When word reached the emperor, the emperor's heart was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he took deep offense.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔罪狀阿爾泰，猶及此事，斥為昧良飾詐。

translations.literal: At this time the edict listing Aertai's crimes still mentioned this matter, denouncing him as blind to loyalty and feigning sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Now the edict condemning Aertai still cited this affair, calling him deceitful and false-hearted.

sentences.zh: 川東道托隆入見，發阿爾泰贓私，下繼任總督富勒渾嚴鞫。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant of Eastern Sichuan Tuolong came to audience, exposing Aertai's corruption and embezzlement; the case was sent to his successor Governor-General Fulehun for strict interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sichuan Circuit Intendant Tuolong came to court and exposed Aertai's graft; his successor Fulehun was ordered to conduct a rigorous trial.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，獄具，擬斬，上命賜自盡。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the trial was complete; execution by decapitation was proposed, but the emperor ordered him granted death by self-disposal.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year the case was closed with a recommendation of decapitation; the emperor ordered him granted suicide instead.

sentences.zh: =桂林=桂林，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，兩廣總督鶴年子。

translations.literal: = Guilin = Guilin, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner, son of Huguang governor-general Henian.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner and the son of Huguang governor-general Henian.

sentences.zh: 桂林自廩生入貲為工部主事。

translations.literal: Guilin entered through the grain-student quota by purchasing office and became a principal secretary in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin bought his way into office from grain-student status and became a principal secretary in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 累遷山西按察使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Judicial Commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to judicial commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年三月，擢戶部侍郎、軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the third month of Qianlong 36 he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and attendant at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Qianlong 36 he became vice minister of revenue and an attendant of the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 九月，命佐定邊右副將軍溫福討金川。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was ordered to assist Frontier Deputy Right General Wen Fu in suppressing Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was ordered to assist Frontier Deputy Right General Wen Fu against Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，授四川總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was appointed Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was made governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 小金川頭人在卡外投文餽土宜，桂林卻不受，檄罪狀其酋僧格桑。

translations.literal: Lesser Jinchuan headmen outside the barrier submitted documents and presented local products; Guilin refused to accept them and issued a proclamation listing the crimes of chieftain Senggesang.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Jinchuan headmen outside the passes sent letters and native gifts; Guilin refused them and issued a denunciation of chieftain Senggesang.

sentences.zh: 旋督兵收約咱，進克其東山梁大小碉五、石卡二十餘。

translations.literal: He soon directed troops to recover Yuezha and advanced to capture five large and small blockhouses on the eastern ridge and more than twenty stone forts.
translations.idiomatic: He soon recovered Yuezha and took five blockhouses large and small on the eastern ridge plus more than twenty stone forts.

sentences.zh: 疏請添調黔、陝兵五千益師，上許益陝、甘兵三千。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting an additional five thousand troops from Guizhou and Shaanxi to reinforce the army; the emperor permitted three thousand from Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for five thousand reinforcements from Guizhou and Shaanxi; the emperor approved three thousand from Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 桂林旋督總兵宋元俊攻卡丫，進據墨爾多山梁。

translations.literal: Guilin soon directed Regional Commander Song Yuanjun to attack Kayak and advanced to hold Moerduo Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin then had Regional Commander Song Yuanjun assault Kayak and seize Moerduo Ridge.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其措置合宜，手詔謂：「無意中用汝，竟能得力。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his arrangements as well suited and wrote in his own hand: "Without intending to use you, I find you quite effective.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his handling of affairs and wrote personally: "I never meant to rely on you, yet you have proved capable.

sentences.zh: 亦賴在軍機處半年，日耹朕訓也。

translations.literal: This also owes to half a year in the Grand Council, daily hearing Our instructions.
translations.idiomatic: That owes something to six months in the Grand Council, hearing my guidance every day.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，克卡丫，复破克郭松、甲木、噶爾金。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he took Kayak and again broke and took Kesong, Jiamu, and Ga'erjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he captured Kayak and then Kesong, Jiamu, and Ga'erjin.

sentences.zh: 進克噶爾金後山梁，分兵攻東山梁，襲阿仰，自墨壟溝進取達烏圍。

translations.literal: He advanced to take the rear ridge of Ga'erjin, divided troops to attack the eastern ridge, struck A'yang, and from Molong Gou advanced to seize Dawuwei.
translations.idiomatic: He took the ridge behind Ga'erjin, sent detachments against the eastern ridge, struck A'yang, and advanced from Molong Gorge toward Dawuwei.

sentences.zh: 是時大金川酋索諾木攻陷革布什咱，屯兵其地。

translations.literal: At this time Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu attacked and took Geshiza and encamped on its territory.
translations.idiomatic: By then Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu had overrun Geshiza and was encamped there.

sentences.zh: 桂林議乘索諾木兵力未備、革布什咱人心未定，與元俊分兵五道並進，並約將軍溫福合擊，密令革布什咱降酋旺勒丹等約其戚加琿爾為內應，遂收革布什咱寨落七十餘裡。

translations.literal: Guilin proposed to exploit Suonuomu's unprepared forces and Geshiza's unsettled morale; with Yuanjun he divided troops into five columns advancing together, also arranged with General Wen Fu for a joint attack, and secretly ordered Geshiza's surrendered chiefs Wangledan and others to arrange their kinsman Jiahuan'er as inner response—thus recovering more than seventy li of Geshiza stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin proposed striking while Suonuomu's forces were unprepared and Geshiza's loyalty still uncertain; he and Yuanjun advanced in five columns, coordinated a joint attack with General Wen Fu, and secretly had surrendered Geshiza chiefs including Wangledan enlist their kinsman Jiahuan'er as an inside agent, recovering more than seventy li of Geshiza settlements.

sentences.zh: 旋令元俊及守備陳定國率綽斯甲布土兵屯甲爾壟壩，進攻默資溝、吉地，斷其水道，進攻丹東。

translations.literal: He soon ordered Yuanjun and Assistant Commander Chen Dingguo to lead Zhuosijia Bu native troops to garrison at Ji'erlongba, attack Mozigou and Jidi, cut off their water routes, and advance against Dandong.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Yuanjun and Assistant Commander Chen Dingguo with Zhuosijia Bu militia to hold Ji'erlongba, assault Mozigou and Jidi, cut the water supply, and press Dandong.

sentences.zh: 上獎桂林甚合機宜，促元俊乘勝深入取索諾木。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Guilin as very well timed and urged Yuanjun to press the advantage deep and capture Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor applauded Guilin's timing and urged Yuanjun to follow up and capture Suonuomu.

sentences.zh: 桂林遣裨將自東山梁墨壟溝越嶺進攻，別遣兵出間道，自札哇窠山梁縋崖設伏師。

translations.literal: Guilin sent junior generals from the eastern ridge across Molong Gou over the mountains to attack, and separately dispatched troops by a hidden route, lowering men down cliffs from Zhawawo Ridge to set ambush forces.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin sent subordinate officers over the eastern ridge via Molong Gorge and detachments by hidden paths to rappel down Zhawawo Ridge and lay ambushes.

sentences.zh: 既度東山梁墨壟溝，札哇窠伏兵亦起，賊敗竄，克大碉一、石卡二十一。

translations.literal: Once they crossed the eastern ridge's Molong Gou, the Zhawawo ambush also rose; the rebels were defeated and fled; one large blockhouse and twenty-one stone forts were taken.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing Molong Gorge on the eastern ridge, the Zhawawo ambush sprang up; the enemy broke and fled, and one major blockhouse and twenty-one stone forts fell.

sentences.zh: 別遣參將常泰環攻黨哩，都司李天貴等攻沙沖，革布什咱頭人為內應，賊盡殲。

translations.literal: Separately he sent Colonel Chang Tai to encircle and attack Dangli, Regimental Commander Li Tiangui and others to attack Shachong; Geshiza headmen served as inner agents and the rebels were utterly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Other columns under Colonel Chang Tai besieged Dangli while Regimental Commander Li Tiangui attacked Shachong, with Geshiza headmen as inside help; the enemy was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 黨哩、沙沖地並復。

translations.literal: The lands of Dangli and Shachong were both recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Dangli and Shachong were recovered.

sentences.zh: 總兵英泰等復攻克達烏官寨。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ying Tai and others again attacked and took Dawu official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ying Tai and others retook the Dawu garrison stockade.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其功，賜御用玉韘。

translations.literal: The emperor commended their achievement and bestowed an imperial jade archer's thumb ring.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded their success with an imperial jade archer's ring.

sentences.zh: 再進攻克格烏巴桑及那隆山嶺。

translations.literal: Advancing again they attacked and took Gewubasang and Nalong Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: They pushed on to Gewubasang and Nalong Ridge.

sentences.zh: 元俊別攻克丹東及覺拉喇嘛寺，誅賊渠三百、番眾百三十餘。

translations.literal: Yuanjun separately attacked and took Dandong and Jue La Lama Temple, executing three hundred rebel chiefs and more than one hundred thirty tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjun separately took Dandong and Jue La Lama Temple, killing three hundred rebel leaders and more than 130 tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 革布什咱地盡复，桂林檄定國將所調綽斯甲布兵駐界上聽調。

translations.literal: Geshiza territory was fully recovered; Guilin ordered Dingguo to station the Zhuosijia Bu troops he had mobilized on the border awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: With Geshiza fully restored, Guilin ordered Dingguo to hold the Zhuosijia Bu troops on the frontier for future orders.

sentences.zh: 上以革布什咱既复，正當乘勝進剿金川，攻其無備，責桂林失算。

translations.literal: The emperor said that since Geshiza was recovered, they should exploit victory to advance against Jinchuan and strike while unprepared—he blamed Guilin for miscalculation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said that with Geshiza back they ought to press the victory into Jinchuan while the enemy was off guard, and he faulted Guilin for poor judgment.

sentences.zh: 桂林复督兵攻達烏東岸山梁，參將薛琮戰沒，琮驍將，深入糧盡。

translations.literal: Guilin again directed troops to attack the eastern-bank ridge at Dawu; Colonel Xue Cong was killed in battle—Cong was a fierce general who had penetrated deep and exhausted his grain.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin again assaulted the eastern ridge at Dawu; Colonel Xue Cong was killed—a bold commander who had pushed deep until his supplies ran out.

sentences.zh: 桂林既失期不會師，又不以時遣援，軍盡覆，疏請治罪，述戰狀不敢盡。

translations.literal: Guilin both missed the deadline for joint action and failed to send relief in time; the army was utterly destroyed; he memorialized asking punishment, describing the battle situation but not daring to tell all.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin missed the rendezvous and failed to send timely relief; the army was annihilated; he asked to be punished and described the battle but withheld the full truth.

sentences.zh: 元俊與散秩大臣阿爾泰劾其虛誑，並言桂林在卡丫建屋宇以居，迫屬僚供應，與副都統鐵保、提督汪騰龍等終日酣飲，諸將罕得見；

translations.literal: Yuanjun and minister without portfolio Aertai memorialized against him for falsehood, also saying Guilin built houses at Kayak to live in, compelled subordinates to supply him, and with Associate Commissioner Tie Bao and Regional Commander Wang Tenglong drank all day—generals rarely saw him;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjun and Aertai accused him of deception, reporting that Guilin had built quarters at Kayak, forced subordinates to wait on him, and spent days drinking with Associate Commissioner Tie Bao and Regional Commander Wang Tenglong while his generals seldom gained audience;

sentences.zh: 密令騰龍畀總兵王萬邦白金五百，贖被掠官兵，希圖掩飾。

translations.literal: he secretly ordered Tenglong to give Regional Commander Wang Wanbang five hundred taels of white silver to redeem captured officers and soldiers, hoping to cover up.
translations.idiomatic: he secretly told Tenglong to give Regional Commander Wang Wanbang five hundred taels to ransom captured troops, hoping to hide the disaster.

sentences.zh: 上奪桂林職，命額駙、尚書、公福隆安馳往按治，尋奏所劾皆虛，惟官兵傷損不即察奏屬實；

translations.literal: The emperor stripped Guilin of office and ordered imperial son-in-law, minister, and duke Fukangan to rush and investigate; soon they reported all accusations were false except that failure immediately to investigate and report officer and soldier casualties was true;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor removed Guilin and sent imperial son-in-law and minister Duke Fukangan to investigate; the inquiry found the charges largely false, though Guilin had indeed delayed reporting casualties;

sentences.zh: 至贖被掠官兵，乃在軍戶部郎中汪承霈聞巴旺、布拉克底土兵歸失道，官兵告桂林，發白金五百交騰龍備賞，事為元俊構陷，請分別治罪。

translations.literal: As for redeeming captured officers and soldiers, while with the army Ministry of Revenue Director Wang Chengpei heard Bawang and Bulakdi native troops returning had lost their way; officers and soldiers reported to Guilin who issued five hundred taels of white silver to Tenglong for rewards—the affair was Yuanjun's fabricated frame-up; they asked separate punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The silver for ransoming captives came when Ministry Director Wang Chengpei, attached to the army, learned that Bawang and Bulakdi militia had lost their way on return; troops reported to Guilin, who issued five hundred taels to Tenglong for rewards—an episode Yuanjun had fabricated; they asked punishments be apportioned accordingly.

sentences.zh: 上以桂林在軍日親曲糱，止圖安逸，不能與士卒同甘苦，致北山梁傷損多兵，不得為無罪，命戍伊犁。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Guilin while in the army was fond of wine, sought only ease, could not share hardship with soldiers, causing many casualties on the northern ridge—he could not be held guiltless—and ordered him exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that Guilin's fondness for drink and comfort in camp, and his failure to share hardships with his men, had contributed to heavy losses on the northern ridge; he could not be fully acquitted and was exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 三十八年七月，予三等侍衛銜，仍詣軍前督糧運。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-eighth year he was given the rank of third-class bodyguard and still sent to the army front to supervise grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-eighth year he was given third-class bodyguard rank and sent back to the front to supervise grain transport.

sentences.zh: 四十年，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was made a first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he was made a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋授四川提督，遷兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Regional Commander of Sichuan, then transferred to Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Sichuan regional commander, then governor-general of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 卒，加太子太保銜，諡壯敏。

translations.literal: He died; he was given the concurrent title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and posthumously named Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died; he was posthumously made Junior Grand Tutor and given the temple name Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: =溫福=溫福，字履綏，費莫氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人，文華殿大學士溫達孫也。

translations.literal: = Wen Fu = Wen Fu, styled Lüshou, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner and grandson of Grand Secretary Wenda of the Hall of Literary Glory.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu, styled Lüshou, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner and the grandson of Grand Secretary Wenda of the Hall of Literary Glory.

sentences.zh: 自繙譯舉人授兵部筆​​帖式。

translations.literal: From translator licentiate he was appointed clerk in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as a translator licentiate and became a clerk in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，累遷戶部郎中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong he rose to director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 外擢湖南布政使，歷四年；

translations.literal: He was promoted outside the capital to Provincial Treasurer of Hunan and served four years;
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Hunan provincial treasurer and served four years;

sentences.zh: 移貴州布政使，亦四年。

translations.literal: transferred to Provincial Treasurer of Guizhou, also four years.
translations.idiomatic: then Guizhou provincial treasurer for another four years.

sentences.zh: 坐平遠民閧訟庭、按治草率，奪職，戍烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: For Pingyuan commoners rioting in the court and perfunctory investigation of the case, he was stripped of office and exiled to Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: After commoners rioted in court at Pingyuan and he handled the case perfunctorily, he was dismissed and exiled to Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，起內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was restored as Reader-in-waiting of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was recalled as a grand secretariat reader.

sentences.zh: 從定邊將軍兆惠討霍集占，戰葉爾羌，槍傷顴。

translations.literal: He followed Frontier General Zhaohui against Khoja Jahan, fought at Yarkand, and was wounded by gunshot in the cheekbone.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Frontier General Zhaohui against the Khoja rebels, fought at Yarkand, and was shot in the cheek.

sentences.zh: 擢內閣學士，遷倉場侍郎，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He was promoted Grand Secretariat academician, transferred to Vice Minister of the Granary, and given the hereditary yunqiwei rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was made a grand secretariat academician and vice minister of the granary and granted the hereditary yunqiwei rank.

sentences.zh: 外授福建巡撫，內遷吏部侍郎、軍機處行走，進理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: He was appointed outside as Governor of Fujian, transferred inside to Vice Minister of Personnel and attendant at the Grand Council, and advanced to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Fujian governor, returned to court as vice minister of personnel and Grand Council attendant, and rose to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，師徵金川，授定邊右副將軍，以侍郎桂林佐之，共討賊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year when troops were sent against Jinchuan he was appointed Frontier Deputy Right General, with Vice Minister Guilin assisting, jointly to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, when troops were mobilized against Jinchuan, he was made Frontier Deputy Right General with Vice Minister Guilin as deputy to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 溫福自汶川出西路，桂林自打箭爐出南路。

translations.literal: Wen Fu marched out the western route from Wenchuan; Guilin marched out the southern route from Dajianlu.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu advanced west from Wenchuan; Guilin advanced south from Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 時小金川頭人澤旺子僧格桑割地乞援於大金川頭人索諾木，索諾木潛遣兵助之。

translations.literal: At this time Lesser Jinchuan headman Zewang's son Senggesang ceded land to beg aid from Greater Jinchuan headman Suonuomu, who secretly sent troops to help.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Jinchuan's Senggesang, son of Zewang, ceded territory to Greater Jinchuan's Suonuomu for help, and Suonuomu secretly sent reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 上命先剿小金​​川，且勿聲大金川罪。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered first to suppress Lesser Jinchuan and not to proclaim Greater Jinchuan's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered them to crush Lesser Jinchuan first and not yet publicize Greater Jinchuan's guilt.

sentences.zh: 溫福至打箭爐，分兵三道入：溫福出巴朗拉，提督董天弼自甲金達援達木巴宗，總督阿爾泰自約咱攻僧格桑。

translations.literal: Wen Fu reached Dajianlu and divided troops into three columns: Wen Fu marched out Balang La, Regional Commander Dong Tianbi from Jiajinda relieved Damubazong, Governor-General Aertai from Yuezha attacked Senggesang.
translations.idiomatic: At Dajianlu Wen Fu split his force three ways: he himself via Balang La, Regional Commander Dong Tianbi from Jiajinda toward Damubazong, and Governor-General Aertai from Yuezha against Senggesang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，擢武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was promoted Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.

sentences.zh: 十二月，至巴朗拉，戰三晝夜，賊敗去。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he reached Balang La; fighting lasted three days and nights and the rebels were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he reached Balang La and fought three days and nights until the enemy broke and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三十七年正月，取達木巴宗。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-seventh year he took Damubazong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-seventh year he captured Damubazong.

sentences.zh: 進攻斯底葉安，而分軍出別斯滿、瑪爾瓦爾濟，兩路夾擊，進克資哩。

translations.literal: He advanced against Sidiye'an and sent separate forces out through Biesiman and Ma'erwa'erji in a two-pronged pincer, advancing to take Zili.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted Sidiye'an while detachments moved through Biesiman and Ma'erwa'erji in a pincer and took Zili.

sentences.zh: 再進克東瑪，再進克路頂宗及喀木色爾，取諸碉寨。

translations.literal: Advancing again he took Dongma, again took Ludingzong and Kamuse'er, and captured the various blockhouses and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on he took Dongma, then Ludingzong and Kamuse'er, seizing the surrounding blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 再進得博爾根山梁，並攻克得瑪覺烏寨落，攻公雅山。

translations.literal: Advancing again he secured Bo'ergen Ridge and also attacked and took Demajuewu settlements, attacking Gongyashan.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed to Bo'ergen Ridge, took Demajuewu, and assaulted Gongyashan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授定邊將軍，以阿桂、豐升額副之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was appointed Frontier General, with Agui and Fengsheng'e as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was made Frontier General with Agui and Fengsheng'e as deputies.

sentences.zh: 進克明郭宗，再進克底木達。

translations.literal: He advanced to take Mingguozong, then advanced to take Dimuda.
translations.idiomatic: He took Mingguozong and then Dimuda.

sentences.zh: 底木達者，僧格桑父澤旺所居寨也。

translations.literal: Dimuda was the stockade where Senggesang's father Zewang lived.
translations.idiomatic: Dimuda was the stockade of Senggesang's father Zewang.

sentences.zh: 師至，俘澤旺，檻致京師，誅於市，而僧格桑奔大金川。

translations.literal: When the army arrived Zewang was captured, caged and sent to the capital, executed in the marketplace, while Senggesang fled to Greater Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: The army captured Zewang, sent him caged to the capital for execution, while Senggesang fled to Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 溫福檄索諾木令縛獻僧格桑，不應。

translations.literal: Wen Fu sent a dispatch ordering Suonuomu to bind and deliver Senggesang; he did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu ordered Suonuomu to turn over Senggesang in chains; Suonuomu refused.

sentences.zh: 上將進討大金川，溫福等疏言：「前此張廣泗徵金川，十路、七路分合不常，實祗有六路，皆以抵勒烏圍、噶爾依為主。

translations.literal: As the emperor was about to advance against Greater Jinchuan, Wen Fu and others memorialized: "Previously when Zhang Guangsi attacked Jinchuan, routes of ten divisions and seven divisions split and merged irregularly—in fact there were only six routes, all aimed mainly at reaching Lewuwei and Ga'eryi.
translations.idiomatic: As the court prepared to attack Greater Jinchuan, Wen Fu memorialized: "When Zhang Guangsi campaigned in Jinchuan, talk of ten or seven routes masked six real axes, all aimed at Lewuwei and Ga'eryi.

sentences.zh: 一為卡撒正路，自美諾至噶爾依，約五程，為傅恆進兵路；

translations.literal: One was the main Kasai route from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, about five stages—the route Fu Heng took;
translations.idiomatic: The main Kasai route from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, about five stages, was Fu Heng's line of march;

sentences.zh: 一為丹壩，自維州橋經番地抵勒烏圍，約二十餘程，中有穆津岡天險，為岳鍾琪進兵路；

translations.literal: one was Danba, from Weizhou Bridge through tribal lands to Lewuwei, about twenty-plus stages, with the great peril of Mujin Gang—Yue Zhongqi's route;
translations.idiomatic: Danba, from Weizhou Bridge through tribal country to Lewuwei, more than twenty stages with the Mujin Gang pass, was Yue Zhongqi's route;

sentences.zh: 一地名僧格桑，自美諾抵噶爾依，六七程，即總兵馬良柱所行路；

translations.literal: one place was called Senggesang, from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, six or seven stages—the route Regional Commander Ma Liangzhu took;
translations.idiomatic: a route named Senggesang, six or seven stages from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, was taken by Regional Commander Ma Liangzhu;

sentences.zh: 一為革布什咱，一為馬爾邦，皆距噶爾依六七程，險狹難行；

translations.literal: one was Geshiza, one was Ma'erbang—both six or seven stages from Ga'eryi, narrow and perilous, hard to traverse;
translations.idiomatic: routes through Geshiza and Ma'erbang, each six or seven stages from Ga'eryi, were narrow and treacherous;

sentences.zh: 一為綽斯甲布寨至勒烏圍三程，至噶爾依亦三程，均隔大河，碉寨林立，難攻。

translations.literal: one was from Zhuosijia Bu stockade three stages to Lewuwei and also three stages to Ga'eryi—both separated by great rivers, blockhouses dense, hard to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuosijia Bu was three stages to Lewuwei and three to Ga'eryi, but great rivers and dense blockhouses made both approaches hard to assault.

sentences.zh: 此外又有俄坡一路，從綽斯甲布寨至勒烏圍，僅二程，路較平。

translations.literal: Besides these there was also the E'po route from Zhuosijia Bu stockade to Lewuwei, only two stages, with a relatively level road.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the E'po route from Zhuosijia Bu to Lewuwei—only two stages and comparatively level.

sentences.zh: 今當由卡撒正路進兵，其俄坡一路，既有綽斯甲布土司原出兵復其侵地，可為犄角。

translations.literal: Now troops should advance by the main Kasai route; as for the E'po route, since the Zhuosijia Bu chieftain originally sent troops to recover invaded lands, it can serve as a flank.
translations.idiomatic: We should advance on the main Kasai route; Zhuosijia Bu can support from the E'po route where it originally recovered seized territory, forming a pincer.

sentences.zh: 其餘各路，分兵牽制，使不能兼顧。

translations.literal: On the remaining routes, divided troops can pin the enemy so they cannot attend to all fronts.
translations.idiomatic: Other routes should be held with detachments to keep the enemy from covering every front.

sentences.zh: 」於是溫福自功噶爾拉入，阿桂自當噶爾拉入，豐升額自綽斯甲布入。

translations.literal: " Then Wen Fu entered from Gongga'er La, Agui from Dangga'er La, and Fengsheng'e from Zhuosijia Bu.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu then entered via Gongga'er La, Agui via Dangga'er La, and Fengsheng'e via Zhuosijia Bu.

sentences.zh: 溫福性剛愎，不廣諮方略，惟襲訥親、張廣泗故事，以碉卡攻碉卡，修築千計。

translations.literal: Wen Fu was by nature stubborn and willful; he did not consult broadly on strategy but only followed the precedents of Neqin and Zhang Guangsi, attacking blockhouses with blockhouses, constructing a thousand or so.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu was headstrong, rarely consulted others on strategy, and copied Neqin and Zhang Guangsi—storming fort with fort and building hundreds of new blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 所將兵二萬餘，強半散在各碉卡。

translations.literal: The troops he commanded numbered more than twenty thousand; more than half were scattered at the various blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Of his twenty thousand-odd troops, more than half were spread among the blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 每逾數日當奏事，即督兵攻碉。

translations.literal: Every few days when he should have reported to the throne, he instead directed troops to attack blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Every few days, when he owed the court a report, he pushed his men to storm another blockhouse instead.

sentences.zh: 士卒多傷亡，諮怨無鬥志。

translations.literal: Soldiers suffered many casualties; complaints spread and they had no fighting spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Casualties mounted, grievances spread, and the troops lost heart.

sentences.zh: 溫福日置酒高會，參贊伍岱歎曰：「焉有為帥若此而能制勝者？

translations.literal: Wen Fu held wine feasts daily; Staff Secretary Wu Dai sighed: "How can a commander like this win victory?
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu feasted daily; Staff Secretary Wu Dai lamented: "What commander who behaves like this can ever win?"

sentences.zh: 」因密疏聞上，溫福亦疏劾伍岱。

translations.literal: " He secretly memorialized the emperor; Wen Fu also impeached Wu Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai secretly reported to the throne; Wen Fu impeached Wu Dai in turn.

sentences.zh: 上命豐升額及額駙色布騰巴勒珠爾按治。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Fengsheng'e and Imperial Son-in-law Sebuteng Balzhu'er to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Fengsheng'e and Imperial Son-in-law Sebuteng Balzhu'er to conduct an inquiry.

sentences.zh: 溫福又言色布騰巴勒珠爾朋比傾陷，上為奪伍岱職，令色布騰巴勒珠爾逮詣熱河行在，獄成，戍伍岱伊犁。

translations.literal: Wen Fu also said Sebuteng Balzhu'er was in league to frame him; the emperor stripped Wu Dai of office, ordered Sebuteng to the Rehe traveling palace; when the case was complete, Wu Dai was exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu claimed Sebuteng Balzhu'er had conspired against him; the emperor dismissed Wu Dai, summoned Sebuteng to the Rehe traveling palace, and after the trial exiled Wu Dai to Yili.

sentences.zh: 三十八年春，溫福師至功噶爾拉，賊阻險，不得進，別取道攻昔嶺，駐軍木果木；

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year Wen Fu's army reached Gongga'er La; the rebels blocked the difficult ground and he could not advance; he took another route to attack Xiling and encamped at Mugumu;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year Wen Fu reached Gongga'er La; the enemy held the passes and blocked him, so he turned to attack Xiling and camped at Mugumu;

sentences.zh: 令提督董天弼分軍屯底木達。

translations.literal: He ordered Regional Commander Dong Tianbi to divide troops and garrison Dimuda.
translations.idiomatic: He posted Regional Commander Dong Tianbi at Dimuda with a detached force.

sentences.zh: 木果木、底木達皆故小金川地，索諾木陰使小金川頭人煽諸降番使復叛。

translations.literal: Mugumu and Dimuda were both former Lesser Jinchuan territory; Suonuomu secretly had Lesser Jinchuan headmen stir the surrendered tribes to rebel again.
translations.idiomatic: Mugumu and Dimuda lay in old Lesser Jinchuan lands; Suonuomu secretly urged Lesser Jinchuan headmen to incite the surrendered tribes to rise again.

sentences.zh: 諸降番以師久頓不進，遂蜂起應之。

translations.literal: The surrendered tribes, because the army had long stalled without advancing, rose up in swarms to answer the call.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the army bogged down, the surrendered tribes rose everywhere in response.

sentences.zh: 先攻底木達，天弼死之，次劫糧台，潛襲木果木。

translations.literal: They first attacked Dimuda and Tianbi died; next they raided the grain depots and secretly struck Mugumu.
translations.idiomatic: They struck Dimuda first and killed Tianbi, then looted the grain depots and surprised Mugumu.

sentences.zh: 溫福不嚴備山後要隘，賊突薄大營，奪砲局，斷汲道。

translations.literal: Wen Fu did not strictly guard the vital passes in the mountains behind; the rebels burst upon the main camp, seized the artillery park, and cut off the water route.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu left the rear passes weakly held; the enemy rushed the main camp, took the artillery yard, and cut the water supply.

sentences.zh: 時大營兵尚萬餘，運糧役數千，爭避入大營，溫福堅閉壘門不納，轟而潰，聲如壞堤，於是軍心益震。

translations.literal: At the time the main camp still had more than ten thousand troops and several thousand transport laborers; all scrambled to enter the camp; Wen Fu firmly shut the stockade gates and would not admit them; they burst out in collapse with a sound like a broken dike—thus morale shook all the more.
translations.idiomatic: The main camp still held over ten thousand soldiers and thousands of carriers, all pressing to get inside; Wen Fu barred the gates; the mass broke out with a roar like a bursting levee, and panic spread through the army.

sentences.zh: 賊四面蹂入，溫福中槍死，各卡兵望風潰散。

translations.literal: The rebels trampled in from four sides; Wen Fu was shot and died; troops at the various forts fled at sight of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy poured in from every side; Wen Fu was shot dead; garrisons at the outposts scattered at once.

sentences.zh: 參贊海蘭察聞警赴援，殿餘兵自間道出。

translations.literal: Staff Secretary Hailancha heard the alarm and rushed to aid, covering the remnant troops as they withdrew by hidden paths.
translations.idiomatic: Staff Secretary Hailancha hurried to help and covered the survivors as they slipped out by back trails.

sentences.zh: 小金川地盡陷。

translations.literal: Lesser Jinchuan territory fell entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Jinchuan was lost entirely.

sentences.zh: 上初聞溫福死，詔予一等伯爵，世襲罔替，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: When the emperor first heard Wen Fu had died, he decreed him a first-class earl with perpetual hereditary rank and enshrined in the Temple of Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: On first news of Wen Fu's death the emperor made him a perpetual first-class earl and honored him in the Temple of Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 既，劉秉恬、海蘭察、富勒渾各疏言溫福僨事狀，命奪伯爵，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: Afterward Liu Bingtian, Hailancha, and Fulehun each memorialized on Wen Fu's failure; he was ordered stripped of the earldom and given the hereditary rank of third-class light chariot commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Later Liu Bingtian, Hailancha, and Fulehun detailed how Wen Fu had ruined the campaign; his earldom was revoked and only a third-class light chariot commandant hereditary rank remained.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，命並罷之。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year he was ordered to revoke both honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year even that reduced honor was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 子勒保、永保，皆有傳。

translations.literal: His sons Lebao and Yongbao each have biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Lebao and Yongbao are each given separate biographies.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：金川再亂，開泰、阿爾泰皆主以番攻番，遲回坐誤。

translations.literal: = Commentary = Commentary says: When Jinchuan rebelled again, Kai Tai and Aertai both advocated letting tribes fight tribes, hesitating until opportunities were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: In the second Jinchuan revolt, Kai Tai and Aertai both favored tribe-against-tribe policies and lost time through hesitation.

sentences.zh: 桂林有宋元俊不能用，反齮齕之，擁兵不進。

translations.literal: Guilin could not employ Song Yuanjun but instead slandered him, holding troops back without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin failed to use Song Yuanjun and instead undermined him, keeping armies idle.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰與元俊劾桂林，此其意以軍國為重，不屑屑阿貴近、疏卑遠，宜若可成功，乃坐蜚語敗。

translations.literal: Aertai and Yuanjun impeached Guilin—their intent placed military affairs first, disdaining to court the powerful while slighting the distant; success seemed possible, yet they were ruined by rumor.
translations.idiomatic: When Aertai and Yuanjun denounced Guilin they meant to put the war first, not to flatter the powerful or neglect distant fronts; it looked promising, yet rumor undid them.

sentences.zh: 溫福銳進，似勝開泰輩，乃又剛愎，有董天弼不能用，予兵至少，令僻處軍後，卒致僨潰，徒以身殉，豈不惜哉？

translations.literal: Wen Fu pressed forward boldly, seeming to surpass Kai Tai's generation, yet was stubborn, could not employ Dong Tianbi, gave him too few troops and posted him far in the rear, and in the end met catastrophic rout and died in vain—is it not lamentable?
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu marched boldly, as if better than Kai Tai and the rest, yet his obstinacy, refusal to use Dong Tianbi, and posting him in the rear with too few men brought on disaster and a useless death—is that not a bitter waste?
